g.text: 19 recovered drawings + the chosen dragon. Historical attempts, including rejected designs.

svg.title: DeckShelf — tall fitted deckbox
svg.desc: A narrow card deckbox with a raised fitted cap. The card edges are contained inside the opening.

svg.title: DeckShelf — open flip-top deckbox
svg.desc: A tall card deckbox in three-quarter view, with a fitted cap folded back and a packed deck inside.

svg.title: Commander deckbox with folded magnetic lid
svg.desc: A tall cream deckbox in three-quarter view, two visible sleeve edges, a thumb notch and a small diamond on its front.

svg.title: Box with its lid slightly open
Open-top deck holder with a continuous back and side
DeckShelf — deckbox with an open rear flap
DeckShelf — deckbox with an open hinged lid
DeckShelf — rigid case with upright hinged lid
svg.desc: A perspective deck case with a lid joined along its rear edge, two card sleeves, and a star on the front wall.

svg.title: DeckShelf — shallow deck tray
svg.desc: A deck lying flat inside a low four-sided tray. A four-point star marks the top card.

svg.text: Recovered from recorded SVG creation steps; not every later shell-edited variant was recoverable. Geometry is retained.
